entities.summary: Munger, formerly spelt as Monghyr, is a twin city and a Municipal Corporation situated in the Indian state of Bihar. It is the administrative headquarters of Munger district and Munger Division. Munger was one of the major cities in Eastern India and undivided Bengal during Mughal period and British Raj. It is one of the major political, cultural, educational and commercial centers of Bihar and Eastern India. Munger is situated about 180 km (110 mi) east of capital city Patna, about 480 km (300 mi) west of Eastern India's largest city Kolkata and 1,200 km (750 mi) from country's capital New Delhi.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Munger was a major city in Eastern India and undivided Bengal during Mughal period and British Raj, serving as an administrative headquarters of Munger district and Munger Division. Its historical significance lies in its role as a commercial center and educational hub.
